source: Photonic Sun 2.38 Rebalanced: Move Changes.pdf (hacks/photonic-sun/.src; the same change lines are in data.json MV.e: "now boosts Speed", "Now harshly lowers the target's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense stats, as well as poisoning them"). Generation 7 profile.
notes: Rapid Spin: the user's Speed +1 on every hit (doc: "Power 20 => 50, now boosts Speed"; no chance given, so guaranteed)

Toxic Thread: lowers the target's Speed, Defense and Special Defense by two stages each and poisons it (doc: "Now harshly lowers the target's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense stats, as well as poisoning them"); "harshly" is the game's -2 wording, so -2 each, not the vanilla Speed -1 only

Checked, no override: Curse (table already Atk +1 Def +1 Spe -1 for non-Ghost); Steel Wing, Twineedle, Water Pulse, Rock Climb, Chatter, Mud Bomb, Octazooka, Freeze-Dry, Force Palm, Cross Poison (the changed effects are chances, not 100 %, or accuracy / PP only); Dark Void (accuracy only); Mystical Fire (table already Sp. Atk -1 100 %); Fell Stinger not in Photonic's list; Drill Peck and Self-Destruct / Explosion (crit only, not an effect the table holds); Parabolic Charge / Horn Leech / Draining Kiss (drain changes only)

Not modelled, not a change: Rototiller, Flower Shield, Magnetic Flux and Gear Up (stat rises on Grass types / allies with Plus or Minus, a target set the calc has no kind for); Defog (lowers evasion, which is not stored; screen removal is field); Power Split / Guard Split / Speed Swap (stat average / swap, no stage change); Extreme Evoboost (Z-move status, out of scope); Spirit Shackle keeps its trap kind

Rapid Spin.n: Photonic Move Changes.pdf: Rapid Spin now boosts Speed

Toxic Thread.n: Photonic Move Changes.pdf: Toxic Thread harshly lowers Speed, Defense and Special Defense, and poisons

unsourced: Rototiller, Flower Shield, Magnetic Flux, Gear Up: stat rises by target type / ally ability, no kind in the table (the shared table gap, not a Photonic change)
Defog: lowers the target's evasion only (not stored); the screen removal is field state
